blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Sunday said it is planning to bolster its efforts to ensure school safety, following recent cases of fatal school shootings in different parts of the country. According to the PNP, it is eyeing certain safety practices, including those implemented in neighboring countries, as it welcomed the proposal of Education Secretary Sonny Angara to create a Joint School Safety Task Force with the Department of the Interior and Local Government and the PNP.
